intermediate.name: Cava de' Tirreni
intermediate.title: KOM Sprint (4) Cava de' Tirreni (40.1 km)

story: A four-man breakaway was kept under tight control throughout the day and caught with 35 kilometres remaining, making way for the expected bunch sprint. Unibet Rose Rockets led the peloton onto the wet cobbled finishing straight, but a late crash involving Dylan Groenewegen, Jonathan Milan and Tobias Lund Andresen threw the finale into chaos. Davide Ballerini and Jasper Stuyven avoided the incident and gained a small advantage, with Ballerini prevailing in a two-man sprint to the line.
